[5:02PM] #Jibowu_Yaba #TrafficUpdate 

Movement from Empire to Jibowu under bridge heading towards Herbert Macaulay Way down to Adekunle intersection, is currently smooth. This favorable condition extends to the return journey from Adekunle intersection to Makoko junction, Panti intersection and Alagomeji. 

Approaching Sabo is experiencing heavy traffic due to traffic light alternation. Similarly, the stretch from St. Agnes down to Unilag junction and Yaba Tech is busy due to ongoing road construction, while movement from WAEC down to Jibowu is slow. 

Jibowu underneath the bridge in both inward and outward directions towards Empire is moving steadily, and traffic from Jibowu inward  Yaba Phase 1 and 2 is flowing faster. The stretch of Murtala Muhammad Way down to Oyingbo is in good condition, as is the flow from Oyingbo inward to Iddo via Otto and Oyingbo inward to Ile Ile.Kano Street inward from Apena Cemetery down to Adekunle is also clear. 

There are no reported impediments, and our officers are actively managing traffic situation.

However, immediately after VFS down to Ikate gate, traffic is busy due to traffic alternation at Ikate. 

For returning traffic, movement from Ikate gate, VFS, Itedo car wash, Dome/Freedom way connecting Zenith junction, UBA/Admiralty road, Road 14, and Road 13 & 14 is generally smooth. Admiralty roundabout en route the Link Bridge is experiencing slightly busy conditions due to the closing hour rush. 

The Alexandra Link Bridge descending towards Admiralty roundabout is also busy due to the presence of a speed breaker bump. Access Junction towards Fam City is currently traffic-free.

 Conversely, movement immediately from Fam City inward Lekki peninsula gate down to Lekki roundabout is slightly busy due to the traffic light alternation at Lekki roundabout.
Our personnel are well positioned at various identified congestion points. No traffic impediments are currently reported.

[5:58PM] #Alausa_Ikeja #TrafficUpdate 

 On Obafemi Awolowo Way, movement from Barrack, Coca-Cola junction, Radio, and Allen junction towards Balogun is generally good. However, traffic becomes busy approaching Olowu junction leading to the Ikeja underneath bridge due to spillover from the Ikeja Along overpass. The return journey on this axis is moving as expected but experiences congestion near Allen junction and Radio junction, respectively. 

Proceeding towards Alausa, the traffic flow is good until the vicinity of Dr. Nurudeen Olowopopo by the traffic light, where it becomes busy.
Lateef Jakande Road is experiencing a faster pace of movement from Coca-Cola junction, LTV8, Mobil, and Cadbury towards the first gate. However, the stretch from Wemco junction to Omole roundabout shows steady movement, with the return journey reported to be proceeding well.

Other corridors within the zone, including Mobolaji Johnson Avenue in both inward and outward directions, Adeniyi Jones inward and outward, and the stretch of Dr. Nurudeen Olowopopo connecting to Otedola underneath the bridge, are all reported to be in good condition. No traffic impediments have been sighted, and officers are actively managing traffic flow as needed.
